2024 Minnesota Statutes

609.185 MURDER IN THE FIRST DEGREE.

A person who causes the death of another with intent to effect the death of that person or another is guilty of murder in the first degree.

Source: https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/609.185

2024 Minnesota Statutes

609.52 THEFT.

Whoever intentionally and without claim of right takes or exercises control over movable property of another may be guilty of theft.

Source: https://www.revisor.mn.gov/statutes/cite/609.52
